paragraphs.text: Rissa "Blades" Lee is a human from an unknown plane who traveled to Thunder Junction between 4562 and 4563 AR, where she has a bounty outstanding.

Rissa Lee is a renowned outlaw on Thunder Junction . A human with black hair and brown skin, she stands out in her Atiin attire. She wears an elaborate poncho and hat with droplet patterns, characteristic of the Atiin's symbolic attire. Rissa has earned the moniker "Blades" , as she is notorious for being able to create magical daggers that fly through the air to their target. Her reputation as a high-profile criminal is cemented by her ability to execute daring crimes and evade capture, which has put a bounty on her back.
